headline: Russia reports nearly 500,000 war casualties
standfirst: Leaked data exposes the massive human cost of the invasion in Ukraine.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Leaked figures indicate Russia has lost nearly 500,000 people during its full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The ongoing war has fundamentally altered mortality patterns across Russia since the invasion began.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: These internal numbers provide a rare, verified look at the scale of human loss from the conflict.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for further analysis on how these casualty figures impact Russia's domestic stability.

caption:
Russia has lost nearly 500,000 people in the war in Ukraine according to leaked internal data.

This figure comes from an analysis of Russian mortality patterns verified by three independent sources. It offers a stark look at the human toll of the conflict that has continued since the full-scale invasion began. We are tracking how these numbers reflect the reality on the ground.
